title.en: 'Alarm bells': The ongoing reality for these Australians as 1940s phenomenon takes hold
title.zh: “警钟敲响”：1940年代现象重现，这些澳大利亚人面临的持续现实

summary.en: A recent analysis indicates that homeownership rates for younger Australians (25-34 years old) have fallen to levels last seen in the 1940s, with fewer than 40% owning their homes. This stagnation occurs amidst rising home prices and rents, making it increasingly difficult for this demographic to save for a mortgage....
summary.zh: 最新分析显示，年轻澳大利亚人（25至34岁）的住房拥有率已降至1940年代的水平，其中不足40%的人拥有自己的住房。这种停滞发生在房价和租金上涨的背景下，使得这一年龄段的人群越来越难以储蓄以支付抵押贷款。一位专家指出，基本政策领域的失误是导致这一趋势的原因之一。

body.en:
The number of younger Australians who own their own homes has stagnated, sitting at around the same levels recorded during World War Two, as the cost of living and rents rise.

Fewer than 40 per cent of 25 to 34-year-olds were listed as homeowners in the 2021 Census, and that rate is expected to have fallen since, according to analysis from social welfare charity Anglicare Australia.

This is equivalent to the homeownership rate recorded in the 1940s, before the post-war boom took hold as multiple policies prioritised construction and housing for veterans.

At the same time, home prices and rents have risen, putting pressure on younger Australians to save for a mortgage while living away from home.

A recent report from property data company Cotality has shown that rents in some parts of Australia have soared by 80 per cent over the last five years, since COVID-era rent freezes were lifted.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Anglicare Australia said that support lines for younger people are dominated by stress over housing security and related bills.

"It's almost impossible to have a call from a younger person who doesn’t mention the stress of rents or bills," Anglicare Australia executive director Kasy Chambers told SBS News.

"They are studying, working and contributing. But they are earning less than the generations before them, being locked out of housing, and struggling to build the security that past generations took for granted."

Home ownership has steadily declined across age groups since the 1970s, but younger Australians have felt the sharpest declines, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

Angela Jackson, an economist at the Productivity Commission, the Australian government's independent economic advisory body, said home ownership is particularly hard for lower socioeconomic groups.

"It is a lot more expensive relative to people's incomes to get into the housing market than it was for Gen Z's parents or grandparents," she told SBS News.

Home ownership rates have declined generation on generation in Australia, off the back of the housing boom in the post-war era.

Liz Allen, a demographer and social researcher from ANU, described 1940s Australians as going through "tough times".

"There were issues with inequalities, especially around education, geographic and income and wealth inequality," she said.

"I think it would be fair to say that the inequalities faced in that period and the global shocks during that period surpassed those that we're experiencing now."

Home ownership across all ages was lower than it is today, with younger people aged 25-34 the least likely to own property.

title.en: 130,000 or 230,000? The migration figures One Nation is trying to explain
title.zh: 13万还是23万？一国组织试图解释的移民数据

summary.en: Conflicting comments from One Nation figures have raised questions about the party's migration target.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has faced questions over his party's immigration target, claiming fellow MP David Farley misspoke when he revealed their figures were "not too different" from Labor's.

The MP for Farrer told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday that One Nation's stated figure of 130,000 net overseas migration annually into Australia did not include those who enter under a Pacific labour scheme, aged-care nurses, and other in-demand skilled workers.

He conceded that those groups would add roughly 100,000 people, bringing their total to 230,000 — 5,000 fewer than the current Labor budget projections.

Party leader Pauline Hanson intervened just hours later, writing on social media that One Nation's policy is to reduce net overseas migration (NOM) to 130,000.

Speaking to Channel Seven's Sunrise program on Monday, Joyce added that Farley simply made a mistake while explaining the numbers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Show me a political career where people haven't made a mistake, and I'll show you a person who's not told the truth," Joyce said.

"I'm not going to throw anybody under a bus. When people are new in parliament, they can sometimes get things incorrect, and that's what happens. God knows, I've done it enough."

The debate over Australia's migration figures has intensified in recent months, with a recent Redbridge/Accent Research poll, conducted for the Australian Financial Review, indicating that voters trust One Nation and its traditionally restrictive approach to handle migration better than Labor or the Liberal Party.

However, the disjointed nature of One Nation's ongoing public discourse on the topic has prompted claims that the party is "incoherent" and "not fit to govern" from federal minister Pat Conroy.

Since its 1997 inception, cutting immigration has been seemingly a foundational pillar of One Nation policy. During her first speech to federal parliament, Hanson alleged Australia was in danger of being "swamped by Asians", that migrants never assimilated, and that multiculturalism should be abolished.

Its website currently states One Nation would "cut immigration by over 570,000 people" through "capping visas at 130,000 per year".

In a social media post on Sunday, Hanson wrote that NOM would be cut to 130,000 — a figure the party has previously clarified to SBS News . This number would be achieved by reducing international students, temporary graduate visas, and a "much more targeted" skilled migration program, Hanson said.

Those figures are different to the ones put forward by Farley, who said One Nation is focusing on "the NOM in its true form", as separate to labour programs "that drive our...
body.zh: 一国党议员巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) 面临有关该党移民目标的质疑，声称同僚议员戴维·法利 (David Farley) 在透露他们的数字与工党的数字“相差不大”时说错了话。 法雷尔议员周日告诉美国广播公司的 Insiders 节目，一国党公布的每年有 13 万名海外净移民进入澳大利亚的数字不包括根据太平洋劳工计划进入的人、老年护理护士和其他急需的技术工人。 他承认这些团体将增加大约 10 万人，使总人数达到 23 万人——比当前工党预算预测少 5,000 人。 几小时后，该党领导人保琳·汉森(Pauline Hanson)介入，她在社交媒体上写道，一国党的政策是将海外净移民(NOM)减少到13万人。 乔伊斯周一在第七频道的《日出》节目中补充说，法利只是在解释这些数字时犯了一个错误。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 乔伊斯说：“向我展示一个人们没有犯过错误的政治生涯，我就会向你展示一个没有说实话的人。” “我不会把任何人扔到公共汽车下。当人们刚进入议会时，他们有时会弄错事情，这就是发生的事情。上帝知道，我已经做得足够多了。” 近几个月来，有关澳大利亚移民数据的争论愈演愈烈，Redbridge/Accent Research 最近为《澳大利亚金融评论》进行的一项民意调查显示，选民相信一国党及其传统的限制性政策，能够比工党或自由党更好地处理移民问题。 然而，一国党持续就这一话题进行的公开讨论的脱节性质促使联邦部长帕特·康罗伊声称该党“语无伦次”且“不适合执政”。 自 1997 年推出以来，减少移民似乎一直是一国政策的基本支柱。汉森在联邦议会的第一次演讲中声称澳大利亚面临“被亚洲人淹没”的危险，移民永远不会被同化，多元文化主义应该被废除。 其网站目前表示，一国党将通过“每年 13 万个签证上限”来“减少超过 57 万移民”。 汉森在周日的社交媒体帖子中写道，NOM 将削减至 13 万人——该党此前已向 SBS 新闻澄清了这一数字。汉森表示，这一数字将通过减少国际学生、临时毕业生签证和“更有针对性”的技术移民计划来实现。 这些数字与法利提出的数字不同，法利表示，一国党正在关注“真正形式的 NOM”，与“推动我们……的劳工计划”分开。

title.en: Rush to vaccinate little penguins against H5N1 as another seal is diagnosed
title.zh: 随着另一只海豹被诊断出感染H5N1，人们正紧急为小企鹅接种疫苗

summary.en: A second seal in South Australia has likely contracted the H5N1 bird flu virus, prompting an urgent vaccination program for the iconic little penguin population on Phillip Island to prevent further spread.
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚的第二只海豹可能感染了H5N1禽流感病毒，促使菲利普岛紧急启动了为其标志性小企鹅种群接种疫苗的计划，以防止病毒进一步传播。

body.en:
Bird flu has likely spread to a second seal, one day after the first mammal in Australia was confirmed to have contracted the virus.

Five suspected H5 bird flu cases were recorded in South Australia on Monday, including a long-nosed fur seal at The Pages Conservation Park, the state's Department of Primary Industries and Regions said in a statement on Monday morning.

The Pages — which covers two small islands between Kangaroo Island and the mainland — is a haven for the endangered Australian sea lion.

The fur seal has been tested for bird flu, with results expected in the coming days.

The first positive case of the virus in a mammal was confirmed on Sunday in a long-nosed fur seal at Beachport, 300km south of Adelaide, which authorities believed was contracted from wild birds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Before the new case was announced, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the spread from birds to mammals was inevitable and the government was examining whether further vaccination programs were needed.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear. But we also need to be realistic," he told ABC TV on Monday.

"This is what we've seen happen overseas. Australia is very fortunate that we've been the last continent on Earth to have this strain of bird flu happen. But we are likely to see those kind of events as we have overseas."

Agriculture Minister Julie Collins said the federal government was investigating whether bird flu vaccines were available for use in mammals.

"There are trials underway in North America, in California and Hawaii, and this is using a vaccine that's been developed for cattle," she told ABC radio.

"There certainly is nothing commercially available, but we do continue to look at that research."

Bird flu vaccinations have been rolled out to at-risk species, including the little penguins on Victoria's Phillip Island.

Many were corralled into pens to receive the first of two vaccinations on Sunday night.

With case numbers on the rise, authorities have stepped in to do what they can to defend the 5,000-strong colony.

The penguins' nightly ritual of returning to the same burrow, along the same path, made them ideal candidates for vaccination, Phillip Island Nature Parks reserve manager Ben Thomas said.

As a world-first in scale, the process has taken some experimentation and fine-tuning.

"We've had our teams out late into the night for a week now and learning a lot along the process," Thomas said.

"We started on some of the quieter penguin pathways to fine-tune the whole process and get it working as quickly as we...

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department reported a modest turnout on the first day of its reservation trial for the Po Pin Chau trail located in Sai Kung East Country Park. As of 6pm on Monday, about 200 of the 2,000 daily slots had been booked for September 5 and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department reported a modest turnout on the first day of its reservation trial for the Po Pin Chau trail located in Sai Kung East Country Park. As of 6pm on Monday, about 200 of the 2,000 daily slots had been booked for September 5 and 6 – representing just 10 percent of the quota. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme on Tuesday, Esther To, an assistant director at the department, attributed the sluggish take-up to the ongoing summer heat. "It might be because the weather is still quite hot, so the number of visitors is definitely going to be lower. We expect that the number will only start to pick up around the Mid-Autumn Festival or the October Golden Week," she said. The pilot scheme, which requires visitors to register using their real names, is designed to protect the trail’s natural environment, enhance the overall visitor experience, and assess the site's carrying capacity, according to To. She noted that the 2,000-slot daily limit was set based on past foot traffic during Golden Week holidays, the trail’s length, and typical visitor behaviour patterns – factors she believes make the quota appropriate. When asked whether the absence of a time limit could lead to overcrowding, To explained that the round-trip route at Po Pin Chau spans roughly two kilometres and is typically completed within two hours. She added that during the Labour Day Golden Week in May, the department had already introduced crowd control measures at popular viewpoints. "If too many people gather there for photos, we would direct them to keep moving. Essentially, most people gather at the photo spot, take their pictures, and then follow the trail down," she said. "They rarely linger in between because the area is exposed – it's either too hot, too windy, or even rainy, so they tend to come down after taking their photos." Regarding the lack of penalties for no-shows or a fee structure, To said the department is taking a gradual approach, as country parks have historically operated without charges. She encouraged visitors to cancel their reservations at least 48 hours in advance if their plans change. Through the pilot scheme, the department will monitor no-show rates and later decide whether or not to introduce penalties or fees. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 渔农自然护理署报告称，位于西贡东郊野公园的破边洲径的预留试验首日参加人数不多。截至周一下午 6 点，9 月 5 日至 6 日的每日 2,000 个时段中约有 200 个已被预订——仅占配额的 10%。周二，该部门助理处长杜淑仪在香港电台的一个广播节目中表示，收视率低迷的原因是持续的夏季炎热。 “可能是因为天气还很热，所以游客数量肯定会减少。我们预计，中秋节或十月黄金周前后，游客数量才会开始回升。”她说。杜表示，试点计划要求游客实名登记，旨在保护步道的自然环境、提升整体游客体验并评估场地的承载能力。她指出，每日 2,000 个停车位的限制是根据过去黄金周假期期间的人流量、步道长度和典型游客行为模式而设定的，她认为这些因素使配额是合适的。当被问及没有时间限制是否会导致人满为患时，杜解释说，破边洲的来回路线全长约两公里，通常在两小时内完成。她补充，五月五一黄金周期间，该部门已在热门观点推出人流控制措施。 “如果太多人聚集在那里拍照，我们会引导他们继续前进。基本上，大多数人聚集在拍照点，拍照，然后沿着小路下去，”她说。 “他们很少在这之间徘徊，因为该地区暴露在外——要么太热，要么风太大，要么甚至下雨，所以他们往往会在拍照后下来。”关于没有对缺席的处罚或收费结构，杜表示，该部门正在采取渐进的方法，因为郊野公园历来都是免费运营的。她鼓励游客如果计划有变，至少提前 48 小时取消预订。通过试点计划，该部门将监测缺席率，然后决定是否征收罚款或费用。谭咏麟编辑

summary.en: Close to 80 per cent of low-income elderly residents in Hong Kong report suffering physical or mental distress related to extreme heat, a Greenpeace survey has found, highlighting the demographic’s vulnerability to rising temperatures. Greenpeace said on Monday that it surveyed...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Close to 80 per cent of low-income elderly residents in Hong Kong report suffering physical or mental distress related to extreme heat, a Greenpeace survey has found, highlighting the demographic’s vulnerability to rising temperatures. Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Greenpeace said on Monday that it surveyed 127 residents aged 65 or above across seven districts with rapidly ageing populations. Among the respondents, more than half live in public rental flats while 35.4 per cent reside in “inadequate housing” such as subdivided units or rooftop squatter huts. Those living alone or with an elderly partner accounted for 60 per cent of respondents, the NGO said. The survey, conducted in June and July this year, found that 78.7 per cent of respondents reported experiencing at least one form of heat-related discomfort affecting their health, mood, or sleep. A total of 5.5 per cent said they had been hospitalised due to a heat-related illness in the past year. ‘Silent killer’ Greenpeace campaigner Prudence Yeung said in a statement that extreme heat is a “silent killer” for the elderly population. “Elderly people are at high risk from extreme heat due to declining physiological functions, and some suffer from chronic illnesses,” Yeung was quoted as saying in the Chinese-language statement. Between 2015 and 2024, the number of hospital discharges and deaths related to heatstroke among patients aged 65 or above rose 16-fold from four to 68, Yeung said, citing official data Greenpeace obtained from the Department of Health. This increase was the sharpest among all age groups and did not include patients who were hospitalised due to other heat-related conditions, she added. Greenpeace campaigner Prudence Yeung. Photo: Greenpeace. Greenpeace also found that more than 70 per cent of elderly residents tended to underestimate heat-related health risks, believing that they would not suffer from heatstroke if they stayed at home. Surviving Hong Kong’s sweltering summer: A comprehensive guide to beating the heat and staying safe About a third of respondents said they never or rarely use air conditioning, even during extreme temperatures. That figure rose to 55 per cent among those living in inadequate housing, with respondents citing a lack of air conditioner units or high electricity bills as their primary reasons. Meanwhile, about 80 per cent of respondents said they had not received any heat-related community services, such as cooling supplies or educational resources, in the previous two years. This highlights a lack of social support surrounding rising temperatures, the NGO said. Nearly 60 per cent found government support during extreme heat to be insufficient, while 27 per cent said they...
body.zh: 绿色和平组织的一项调查发现，近 80% 的香港低收入老年居民表示，他们因酷热而遭受身体或精神困扰，这突显了该人群对气温上升的脆弱性。 2026 年夏季，香港遭遇破纪录的热浪。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。绿色和平组织周一表示，对人口迅速老龄化的七个地区的 127 名 65 岁或以上居民进行了调查。受访者中，超过一半居住于公屋，而35.4%则居住于劏房或天台寮屋等“不足房屋”。该非政府组织表示，独居或与年长伴侣居住的人占受访者的 60%。这项于今年 6 月和 7 月进行的调查发现，78.7% 的受访者表示经历过至少一种与热有关的不适，影响了他们的健康、情绪或睡眠。共有 5.5% 的人表示，他们在过去一年中曾因中暑而住院。 “无声杀手”绿色和平组织活动人士杨杨在一份声明中表示，极端高温是老年人口的“无声杀手”。中文声明援引杨的话说：“由于生理功能下降，老年人面临高温的风险很高，有些人还患有慢性疾病。”杨说，2015年至2024年期间，65岁或以上患者因中暑而出院和死亡的人数增加了16倍，从4人增加到68人，绿色和平组织从卫生署获得的官方数据。她补充说，这一增幅在所有年龄段中是最显着的，并且不包括因其他与高温相关的疾病而住院的患者。绿色和平活动家 Prudence Yeung。照片：绿色和平组织。绿色和平组织还发现，超过70%的老年居民往往低估与高温相关的健康风险，认为如果呆在家里就不会中暑。度过香港酷热的夏季：避暑和保持安全的综合指南 约三分之一的受访者表示，他们从不或很少使用空调，即使在极端气温下也是如此。在居住在住房不足的人中，这一数字上升至 55%，受访者认为缺乏空调或高电费是他们的主要原因。与此同时，约80%的受访者表示，他们在过去两年中没有接受过任何与高温相关的社区服务，例如降温用品或教育资源。该非政府组织表示，这凸显了气温上升缺乏社会支持。近 60% 的人认为政府在酷暑期间的支持不够，而 27% 的人表示他们...

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. body.en: The chairman of the Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company, Jeffrey Lam, has welcomed the government’s decision to grant them an additional 20 percent of land size upon formation carried out by the winning tender of the first large-scale development project at the Northern Metropolis, saying it shows the authorities' determination towards industry development at the site. The Development Bureau on Monday said it awarded a nearly 11-hectare project in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area to HSK New Development Limited which comprises six shareholders: China Overseas Land and Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land, China Travel Service, JD.com and a subsidiary of Sino Land. Apart from flattening and developing three residential sites and building a smart logistics centre on an "Enterprise and Technology Park" site, the consortium will be tasked with forming various remaining sites in the pilot area, to be handed back to the government later. Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said two of the “Enterprise and Technology Park” sites of 4.5 hectares will be granted to Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company upon formation, increasing the size of sites at a nominal land premium for 50 years from 23 hectares to 27.5 hectares, to allow firms to settle in early once the site formation is completed in 2028. Lam said that the decision highlighted the government’s support for the park company and the emphasis on industrial development. He added that the newly allocated sites will help the park company to establish a regional industrial ecosystem at Hung Shui Kiu and enhance its appeal to businesses and talents. Meanwhile, Ryan Ip, vice president of the think-tank Our Hong Kong Foundation, said the winning consortium has expertise in various fields, which will help expedite the development of the mega project. “Each of the corporate has its own merit. You have a developer with long history of local operations, and then you also have large SOE [state-owned enterprise] developers who have strong experience on operating this kind of I&T enterprises on the mainland, and then you also have an established, large logistics operator,” said Ip, who's also a member of the Advisory Committee on the Northern Metropolis. “So I think it bring a lot of different experience to Hong Kong not only on residential development, but also on the operation of technology park, and also on the operations of high-end logistics facilities.” JD.com – the anchor tenant at the centre – will start operations within 55 months, which Ip described as an “aggressive timeline” compared with the minimum requirement of 96 months in the tender documents. “I think they have to work very hard to achieve that not only on a smooth construction schedule, but also they will have to...

title.en: 'Link workers' help fight elderly loneliness
title.zh: “链接工作者”帮助对抗老年人的孤独感

summary.en: One of Ben Wong's clients is an elderly man who shunned others after his dog died. "At his home, there were only some instant noodles and alcohol," Wong spoke about his client's sense of isolation. The volunteer "link worker" noted it took him some time to gradually get the man...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: One of Ben Wong's clients is an elderly man who shunned others after his dog died. "At his home, there were only some instant noodles and alcohol," Wong spoke about his client's sense of isolation. The volunteer "link worker" noted it took him some time to gradually get the man to open up, revealing more about himself and his beloved four-legged companion. Among the activities planned was a funeral to allow his client to bid farewell to his dog. Accompanied by Wong, he also met with other dog owners and went to parks and markets. "We also took the elderly man to the district elderly community centre, and he even did rehearsals for the centre's Christmas party," Wong said. "He also started to do hotpots with other senior residents and said hi to his friends." Wong, who's in his fifties and an accountant by profession, is training to become a volunteer "link worker" to help elderly people fight their loneliness by linking them with the appropriate activity resources. He is among a batch of 60 "link workers" under a programme that offers "social prescriptions" for some 300 senior citizens in New Territories East, including Tin Shui Wai, Tuen Mun and Yuen Long. "Social Prescribing Lab 2.0", to be launched next year, was organised by Make A Difference Institute, the city's first community-initiative public services innovation lab, to provide personalised services for those in need. The group said Hong Kong is grappling with a "loneliness epidemic", with one in five people reporting they feel lonely. That's higher than the global average of 16 percent. Roughly 520,000 Hongkongers also noted that they are "self-isolating", unwilling to confide in family, friends or even AI, according to surveys. "[For] many of the senior residents, actually they don't have the physical illnesses, what they really need is the 'social prescribing' to help them cope with loneliness," the institute's chairwoman Ada Wong said. Dicky Chow, assistant research director of the think tank, Our Hong Kong Foundation, highlighted the differences between social workers in general and these "social prescribing link workers". He said while social workers offer various types of services, "link workers" bring their clients to the actual social venues or help them access social resources. "'Social prescribing' is actually serving as a bridge between medical and social sectors," Chow said. "It's connecting the social sectors with the healthcare sectors, but at the same time, it is not [done] through just referrals, but more about accompanying the elderly, the patients... go through the whole journey with them. "And this is particularly helpful in solving a lot of health concerns, especially loneliness and chronic diseases, because they're actually affected by social determinants of health...
body.zh: Ben Wong 的一位客户是一位老人，在他的狗死后，他避开了其他人。 “在他的家里，只有一些方便面和酒，”黄谈到他的客户的孤立感。这位志愿者“链接工作人员”指出，他花了一些时间才逐渐让这名男子敞开心扉，透露更多关于他自己和他心爱的四足伙伴的信息。计划的活动之一是举行葬礼，让他的客户告别他的狗。在黄的陪同下，他还与其他狗主人会面，并去了公园和市场。黄说：“我们还带老人到区长者社区中心，他甚至为中心的圣诞晚会进行排练。” “他还开始和其他老人一起做火锅，并向朋友们打招呼。”黄先生五十多岁，职业是会计师，他正在接受培训，成为一名志愿者“联络员”，通过为老年人联系适当的活动资源来帮助他们克服孤独感。他是一项计划中的60名“链接工作者”之一，该计划为新界东（包括天水围、屯门和元朗）的约300名老年人提供“社会处方”。将于明年推出的“社会处方实验室2.0”是由Make A Difference Institute组织的，该实验室是该市第一个社区倡议的公共服务创新实验室，旨在为有需要的人提供个性化服务。该组织表示，香港正在应对“孤独流行病”，五分之一的人表示他们感到孤独。这高于 16% 的全球平均水平。调查显示，大约 52 万香港人还表示，他们正在“自我隔离”，不愿向家人、朋友甚至人工智能倾诉。 “对于许多老年居民来说，实际上他们并没有身体疾病，他们真正需要的是‘社会处方’来帮助他们应对孤独，”该研究所的主席 Ada Wong 说。团结香港基金智囊团助理研究主任周卫健强调了一般社会工作者与这些“社会处方链接工作者”之间的差异。他说，虽然社会工作者提供各种类型的服务，但“链接工作者”将他们的客户带到实际的社交场所或帮助他们获取社会资源。 “‘社会处方’实际上是医疗和社会部门之间的桥梁，”周说。 “它正在将社会部门与医疗部门联系起来，但同时，它不仅仅是通过转介来完成的，而是更多地陪伴老年人、患者……与他们一起经历整个旅程。“这对于解决很多健康问题特别有帮助，特别是孤独和慢性病，因为它们实际上受到健康的社会决定因素的影响......

title.en: China abruptly delays unmanned moon mission over ‘launch conditions’
title.zh: 中国因“发射条件”突然推迟无人登月任务

summary.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket. Photo: CCTV screenshot. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved sending the Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket, “does not meet launch conditions and cannot take place during the planned window this year”. The decision to delay was “based on the principle of prudence, reliability and absolute mission success,” it added, without providing further details on what conditions weren’t met or when the launch would be rescheduled. The mission — meant to search for water on the moon’s south pole — was scheduled to depart either over the weekend or Monday, according to media reports. Last week, the agency said the probe and carrier rocket had been moved to the takeoff area at Wenchang Space Launch Center in southern Hainan province. As of Wednesday, the takeoff site and equipment were in good condition, with inspections to take place and a launch “scheduled for the coming period”. The Chang’e-7 delay comes just under two weeks after media reports showed a rocket launched from the Hainan site had exploded, as crowds watched a fiery ball in the sky. The failed mission involved a Long March 7A carrier rocket, which had lifted off from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, state news agency Xinhua said at the time. China’s Long March 7A carrier rocket exploded on Monday, August 10, 2026. Photo: Supplied. An “anomaly” occurred when the rocket carrying the Zhongxing-4B communications satellite was in flight, Xinhua added. The cause of the failure was under investigation, it said. Beijing has ploughed billions of dollars into its space programme in recent years to achieve what President Xi Jinping calls the country’s “space dream”. China successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in July, according to its space agency, marking a major step in its space ambitions and in reducing launch costs. The country is aiming to land astronauts on the Moon before 2030, a race in which the United States is also competing with its Artemis programme.
body.zh: 中国载人航天局周日表示，将推迟一项研究月球任务，该任务是北京计划在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球的努力的一部分，距离一次罕见的发射失败还不到两周。长征五号运载火箭上的嫦娥七号月球探测器。照片：央视截图。该机构表示，经过“全面评估”，此次由长征五号运载火箭发射嫦娥七号月球探测器的任务“不符合发射条件，不能在今年计划的窗口期进行”。它补充说，推迟的决定是“基于审慎、可靠和任务绝对成功的原则”，但没有提供有关哪些条件不满足或何时重新安排发射的进一步细节。据媒体报道，该任务旨在在月球南极寻找水，计划在周末或周一出发。上周，该机构表示，探测器和运载火箭已转移至海南省南部文昌航天发射中心的起飞区。截至周三，起飞场地和设备状况良好，将进行检查并“计划在未来一段时间内”发射。嫦娥七号的发射推迟不到两周，此前媒体报道称，一枚从海南发射场发射的火箭发生爆炸，当时人群正在观看天空中的一个火球。官方通讯社新华社当时称，此次失败的任务涉及一枚从文昌航天发射场升空的长征七号甲运载火箭。中国的长征七号甲运载火箭于 2026 年 8 月 10 日星期一爆炸。照片：提供。新华社补充说，搭载中星四号B通信卫星的火箭在飞行过程中出现“异常”。声明称，故障原因正在调查中。近年来，北京已在太空计划上投入了数十亿美元，以实现习近平主席所说的国家“太空梦想”。据中国航天局称，中国于 7 月首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，标志着其太空雄心和降低发射成本迈出了重要一步。该国的目标是在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球，美国也在这场竞赛中与其阿耳忒弥斯计划展开竞争。

title.en: Shein to make market debut in Hong Kong next Tuesday
title.zh: Shein 将于下周二在香港上市

summary.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. Shein app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and HK$49.50, raising up to HK$13.86 billion (US$1.7 billion), it said in a filing to the bourse. The final price will be announced on August 31, but the higher figure would value the company at around US$26.8 billion. Founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, Shein finally won Beijing’s approval last month to make its initial public offering in Hong Kong. Plans to list in New York and London had been held back in recent years by regulatory hurdles, according to media reports. With most of its factories located in China, Shein sets itself apart from its competitors thanks to the speed of its product design and its highly efficient production and supply chain. Its vast selection of products at stunningly low prices has brought Shein into the same league as Amazon in the United States. With the funds raised from the market, Shein said it aims to finance its technological capabilities as well as boost its international presence. Growing scrutiny Shein reported a full-year net profit of US$2.06 billion in 2025 but swung to a $99 million quarterly loss as the United States scrapped an import duty exemption on small packages. The firm moved its headquarters to Singapore between 2021 and 2022, a move analysts say was intended to avoid increasing global scrutiny of Chinese firms. But it still benefits from China’s unique combination of a huge, low-cost textile manufacturing sector and a highly sophisticated e-commerce logistics network. The company ranks suppliers by their flexibility and ability to deliver urgent orders, and regularly eliminates the poorest performers, according to a 2021 Zhongtai Securities report. By the end of last year, its European customer base rose to 156 million average monthly users, making Shein one of the continent’s biggest e-commerce platforms alongside China’s AliExpress (193 million users) and Amazon (around 180 million). Shein has been scrutinised over its environmental footprint and allegations of human rights violations, though its executive chairman told AFP last year that the company has “zero tolerance” on forced labour. Activists from Mouv’Enfants, an association for the protection of children, stage a protest during the opening of Asian e-commerce giant Shein’s first physical store at the Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) in Paris on November 5, 2025. Photo: Mouv’Enfants, via Facebook. Shein also drew criticism last year in France over the discovery of...
body.zh: 这家快时尚零售商周一表示，Shein 将于 9 月 1 日在香港证券交易所上市，这是一次期待已久的上市，该集团的估值将接近 270 亿美元。谢因应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该在线零售商计划以 47.60 港元至 49.50 港元的价格发行 2.8 亿股股票，筹集至多 138.6 亿港元（17 亿美元）。最终价格将于 8 月 31 日公布，但较高的价格将使该公司估值约为 268 亿美元。 Shein 成立于中国，现总部位于新加坡，上个月终于获得北京方面的批准，在香港进行首次公开​​募股。据媒体报道，近年来在纽约和伦敦上市的计划因监管障碍而受阻。 Shein 的大部分工厂位于中国，凭借其产品设计速度以及高效的生产和供应链，使其在竞争对手中脱颖而出。 Shein 的产品种类繁多且价格极低，使其与美国的亚马逊处于同一水平。 Shein 表示，通过从市场筹集的资金，其目标是为其技术能力提供资金并提高其国际影响力。日益严格的审查 Shein 报告称，2025 年全年净利润为 20.6 亿美元，但由于美国取消小包装进口关税豁免，季度亏损 9,900 万美元。该公司在 2021 年至 2022 年间将总部迁至新加坡，分析师称此举是为了避免全球对中国公司日益严格的审查。但它仍然受益于中国庞大、低成本的纺织制造业和高度复杂的电子商务物流网络的独特结合。根据中泰证券 2021 年的报告，该公司根据供应商的灵活性和交付紧急订单的能力对供应商进行排名，并定期淘汰表现最差的供应商。截至去年年底，其欧洲客户群平均每月用户数增至 1.56 亿，使 Shein 成为欧洲大陆最大的电子商务平台之一，与中国的全球速卖通（1.93 亿用户）和亚马逊（约 1.8 亿用户）齐名。 Shein 因其环境足迹和侵犯人权的指控而受到审查，尽管其执行主席去年告诉法新社，该公司对强迫劳动采取“零容忍”态度。 2025 年 11 月 5 日，保护儿童协会 Mouv’Enfants 的活动人士在亚洲电子商务巨头 Shein 在巴黎 Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) 的第一家实体店开业期间举行抗议。照片：Mouv’Enfants，来自 Facebook。去年，谢因在法国也因发现……而受到批评。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Access to bilingual education lags behind in Andalusia's rural areas, study reveals
title.zh: 研究显示安达卢西亚农村地区双语教育的普及率落后

summary.en: Over the past two decades, bilingual education programs have significantly expanded within the Spanish education system, with the aim of improving foreign language learning—primarily English—while making it more accessible for all. Although more and more schools are offering...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Over the past two decades, bilingual education programs have significantly expanded within the Spanish education system, with the aim of improving foreign language learning—primarily English—while making it more accessible for all. Although more and more schools are offering bilingual education, they are unevenly distributed across the country, generating inequalities among students.

To shed light on this issue, a study by the University of Córdoba (UCO) analyzed the distribution of bilingual schools across Andalusia, revealing a gap between the most populous cities and municipalities, where the largest number of bilingual schools are concentrated, and rural areas, where they are still scarce.

Previous studies had already pointed to inequalities in urban areas, which are closely tied to families' financial means and the neighborhoods where they live. Now, a new study broadens its scope to address inequalities between municipalities based on population size.

As the authors explain, this line of research aims to assess whether bilingual education programs are ensuring equal opportunities for the entire population, in line with the democratizing purpose for which they were designed. To do so, the study analyzed more than 2,500 primary schools and 1,600 compulsory secondary schools across Andalusia. The conclusion is clear: The larger the municipality, the more likely schools are to offer bilingual instruction.

The paper was published in the Journal of Education Policy by UCO researchers Alberto Álvarez Sotomayor (Department of Social Sciences, Philosophy, Geography, Translation, and Interpretation) and David Gutiérrez Rubio (Department of Mathematics), in collaboration with researcher Juan M. Gómez Espino (Department of Sociology, Pablo de Olavide University) and Carlos Lubián (Department of Political Science and Sociology, University of Santiago de Compostela).

As the authors point out, the data from this study—part of the EQUIBIL project—reveals a substantial difference in the bilingual resources available, which would support claims that these programs are elitist and "urban-focused."

In terms of primary education, 41.8% of schools in Andalusia offer bilingual instruction. In municipalities with more than 20,000 inhabitants, the percentage rises to 48.7%. However, as the focus shifts to smaller communities, the presence of bilingual schools decreases, falling below 20% in municipalities with fewer than 3,000 inhabitants.

The same pattern holds true for secondary schools: 56.1% of Andalusian secondary schools are bilingual, but this percentage rises to 66.7% in...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在过去的二十年中，双语教育项目在西班牙教育系统中得到了显着扩展，其目的是改善外语学习（主要是英语），同时让所有人更容易获得外语学习。尽管越来越多的学校提供​​双语教育，但它们在全国各地的分布不均，造成了学生之间的不平等。 为了阐明这个问题，科尔多瓦大学（UCO）的一项研究分析了安达卢西亚双语学校的分布，揭示了人口最多的城市和直辖市（双语学校数量最多集中）与农村地区（双语学校仍然稀缺）之间的差距。 之前的研究已经指出了城市地区的不平等，这与家庭的经济状况和居住的社区密切相关。现在，一项新的研究扩大了范围，以解决城市之间基于人口规模的不平等问题。 正如作者所解释的那样，这一系列研究的目的是评估双语教育计划是否能够确保全体人口的平等机会，符合其设计的民主化目的。为此，该研究分析了安达卢西亚 2,500 多所小学和 1,600 所义务中学。结论很明确：城市越大，学校就越有可能提供双语教学。 该论文由UCO研究人员Alberto Álvarez Sotomayor（社会科学、哲学、地理学、翻译和口译系）和David Gutiérrez Rubio（数学系）与研究员Juan M. Gómez Espino（巴勃罗·德奥拉维德大学社会学系）和Carlos Lubián（政治学系和口译系）合作发表在《教育政策杂志》上。圣地亚哥德孔波斯特拉大学社会学）。 正如作者所指出的，这项研究（EQUIBIL 项目的一部分）的数据揭示了可用双语资源的巨大差异，这支持了这些项目是精英主义和“以城市为中心”的说法。 在初等教育方面，安达卢西亚41.8%的学校提供​​双语教学。在居民超过 20,000 人的城市中，这一比例上升至 48.7%。然而，随着重点转向较小的社区，双语学校的数量逐渐减少，在居民人数不足 3,000 人的城市中，双语学校的比例降至 20% 以下。 同样的模式也适用于中学：56.1% 的安达卢西亚中学是双语学校，但这一比例在 2019 年上升至 66.7%。

title.en: Hotel stigma may drive Chinese hospitality graduates away from careers
title.zh: 酒店耻辱可能会导致中国酒店管理专业毕业生放弃职业生涯

summary.en: Research published in the International Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development analyzed interviews with more than 300 Chinese hotel interns to examine how perceptions of hotel work affect whether graduates pursue a career in the industry. The findings suggest that...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Research published in the International Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development analyzed interviews with more than 300 Chinese hotel interns to examine how perceptions of hotel work affect whether graduates pursue a career in the industry. The findings suggest that negative perceptions deter graduate interns from pursuing careers in hospitality.

Fundamentally, the team found that occupational stigma—the belief that a profession has low status or is undesirable—was most associated with weaker professional identity. Graduates with this perception generally did not choose hotel work as a career.

The findings highlight a significant recruitment problem for China's hotel industry. Despite its reliance on a large and stable workforce, only an estimated 10% to 20% of hospitality and tourism graduates enter the sector.

Moreover, internships, which are intended to provide graduates with practical experience early in their careers, sometimes reinforce negative perceptions and lead many graduates to leave the sector before they have taken more than a few tentative steps along this career path.

The study found that vocational skills sometimes offset the stigma. Interns with additional skills were less affected by negative perceptions of the industry. This suggests that practical training and professional certification might boost confidence in hotel careers and improve professional identity in the sector.

Feifei Yu et al, Hotel interns' career choice intentions from a high-versus-low climate changing region background, International Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development (2026). DOI: 10.1504/ijesd.2026.155727

Swati Mestri holds a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering and has worked as a content editor since 2019. She has experience editing research documents across technology, health care, and materials science, and has a particular interest in technology and space. Full profile →

summary.en: Ask a chemist to name the strongest single bond in organic chemistry, and they'll likely say carbon-fluorine. It's that bond, repeated dozens of times over, that gives per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) their nickname: forever chemicals. Manufacturers prize PFAS for the...

body.en: Ask a chemist to name the strongest single bond in organic chemistry, and they'll likely say carbon-fluorine. It's that bond, repeated dozens of times over, that gives per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) their nickname: forever chemicals. Manufacturers prize PFAS for the same reason regulators dread them. The bonds barely break down, which is exactly why the compounds are so good at repelling water, oil and heat in everything from semiconductor fabrication to nonstick cookware. This is also why PFAS persist in soil, water and living tissue long after serving their industrial purpose.
body.zh: 如果让化学家说出有机化学中最强的单键，他们很可能会说碳-氟。正是这种重复数十次的化学键赋予全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 绰号：永远的化学品。制造商青睐 PFAS 的原因与监管机构害怕它们的原因相同。这些键几乎不会断裂，这正是这些化合物在从半导体制造到不粘炊具的各种领域中如此出色的防水、防油和防热性能的原因。这也是为什么 PFAS 在发挥其工业用途后很长一段时间内仍存在于土壤、水和活体组织中。

title.en: Tornado tears through French village leaving dozens injured
title.zh: 龙卷风席卷法国村庄，造成数十人受伤

summary.en: The south-western village of Pomas was hardest hit, with hundreds of homes damaged and fifteen people taken to hospital.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A tornado has torn through the French village of Pomas in the country's south-west, injuring 41 people and damaging hundreds of homes.

Local authorities said 15 people were taken to hospital, including a pregnant woman who was injured after her house collapsed on her, according to AFP news agency.

More than 120 emergency workers were deployed to the scene after winds reaching 117km/h (73mph) ripped roofs off houses and damaged an estimated 300 homes on Monday.

French authorities issued an orange alert for thunderstorms in large parts of the country's south-west, which have already been hit by power outages and transport disruptions.

The extreme weather has left about 2,800 homes across 10 villages without electricity, according to officials.

Authorities in the Aude department in south-west France cancelled the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana cycling race in the area after a hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced riders to seek shelter.

Eyewitness footage from the region captured the swirling vortex of the tornado looming in the horizon above houses and trees.

Images from the small village of Pomas, which was the hardest hit, showed uprooted trees, damaged cars and rubble from destroyed homes.

Meanwhile there were flight delays and cancellations at airports in Bordeaux, Marseille, Nice, Toulouse and north of Paris to the north, said Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot.

On average, France experiences several dozen tornadoes per year, according to the country's national weather service Météo-France.

It comes after Europe's summer of unprecedented heatwaves and wildfires, with France's south-west region among the worst affected with an area of 42,000 hectares burnt in one of the largest forest fires since World War Two.
body.zh: 一场龙卷风席卷了法国西南部的波马斯村，造成 41 人受伤，数百间房屋受损。 据法新社报道，地方当局表示，15 人被送往医院，其中包括一名孕妇，她因房屋倒塌压伤而受伤。 周一，时速 117 公里（73 英里）的大风掀翻了房屋屋顶，估计有 300 所房屋受损，超过 120 名紧急救援人员被部署到现场。 法国当局对该国西南部大部分地区发布了雷暴橙色警报，这些地区已经遭受停电和交通中断的影响。 据官员称，极端天气导致 10 个村庄约 2,800 户家庭断电。 法国比利牛斯山脉的冰雹迫使车手寻求庇护，法国西南部奥德省当局取消了该地区环西班牙自行车赛的第三赛段。 该地区的目击者镜头捕捉到龙卷风的漩涡在房屋和树木上方的地平线上若隐若现。 来自受灾最严重的波马斯小村庄的图像显示，树木被连根拔起，汽车受损，房屋被毁，瓦砾遍地。 与此同时，交通部长菲利普·塔巴罗特表示，波尔多、马赛、尼斯、图卢兹以及巴黎北部的机场都出现了航班延误和取消。 据法国国家气象局称，法国平均每年会经历数十次龙卷风。 此前，欧洲夏季遭遇了前所未有的热浪和野火，法国西南部地区是受影响最严重的地区，面积达 42,000 公顷，是第二次世界大战以来最大规模的森林火灾之一。

title.en: What would happen to human interaction if AI could read our emotions?
title.zh: 如果人工智能能够解读我们的情绪，人​​类互动会发生什么？

summary.en: AI systems are increasingly being developed to recognize emotions by analyzing facial expressions, voices, body language and other physiological signals. Although the scientific validity of many of these systems remains contested, they are already being tested in health care and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

AI systems are increasingly being developed to recognize emotions by analyzing facial expressions, voices, body language and other physiological signals. Although the scientific validity of many of these systems remains contested, they are already being tested in health care and security settings.

Rather than focusing on the technology's current shortcomings, PhD candidate Prégent asks a different question: What if these systems work exactly as intended? "Companies are showcasing all the benefits of these technologies," she says. "As philosophers and scholars, it's our job to wave a flag and show what could be at stake if they become reliable."

To explore the implications of fully functioning emotion recognition technologies (ERTs), Prégent developed several future scenarios. One involves a surgeon arriving at a hospital to perform an operation. Before she enters the operating room, an ERT system flags her as emotionally unstable. She is taken aside by her employer and prevented from operating.

The surgeon insists she is perfectly capable of carrying out the procedure. The reason for the alert has nothing to do with her professional skills. She is going through a difficult divorce and is worried about one of her children. Although she deliberately left those concerns at home, the technology has interpreted her emotional state as a reason to question whether she can do her job.

"The technology forces her to expose something that belongs to her private life," Prégent says. "She has to explain what is happening at home and justify why she believes she can still perform the operation. But the system has already judged her emotional state and a decision has been made."

For Prégent, the example illustrates a broader societal risk. People occupy many different social roles throughout their lives: They are surgeons, but also parents, partners, friends and neighbors. They usually decide for themselves which aspects of those roles they bring to a particular situation.

ERT, Prégent argues, could blur those boundaries. If people can no longer hide their inner emotions, the distinction between their private and professional lives is at risk of collapse. Instead of deciding for themselves what they reveal, people may find that technology exposes parts of their emotional lives and forces them to explain or defend them.

Prégent sees similar tensions beyond the workplace. She imagines a government representative delivering a public apology after a fatal incident. However, ERT indicates that they do not feel genuine sadness or regret. Instead of listening to the apology, the public...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 人工智能系统越来越多地被开发来通过分析面部表情、声音、肢体语言和其他生理信号来识别情绪。尽管其中许多系统的科学有效性仍然存在争议，但它们已经在医疗保健和安全环境中进行了测试。 博士候选人 Prégent 没有关注该技术当前的缺点，而是提出了一个不同的问题：如果这些系统完全按照预期工作会怎样？ “公司正在展示这些技术的所有好处，”她说。 “作为哲学家和学者，我们的工作就是挥舞旗帜，表明如果他们变得可靠，可能会面临什么危险。” 为了探索功能齐全的情绪识别技术 (ERT) 的影响，Prégent 开发了几种未来场景。其中一个涉及外科医生到达医院进行手术。在她进入手术室之前，ERT 系统将她标记为情绪不稳定。她被雇主带到一边并被禁止工作。 外科医生坚称她完全有能力进行手术。报警的原因与她的专业技能无关。她正在经历一场艰难的离婚，并担心她的一个孩子。尽管她故意将这些担忧留在家里，但技术已将她的情绪状态解读为质疑她是否能胜任工作的理由。 “技术迫使她暴露一些属于她私生活的东西，”普雷金特说。 “她必须解释家里发生的事情，并证明为什么她相信自己仍然可以进行手术。但系统已经判断了她的情绪状态，并做出了决定。” 对于普雷金特来说，这个例子说明了更广泛的社会风险。人们一生中扮演着许多不同的社会角色：他们是外科医生，也是父母、伴侣、朋友和邻居。他们通常会自己决定将这些角色的哪些方面应用于特定情况。 普雷金特认为，ERT 可能会模糊这些界限。如果人们无法再隐藏自己的内心情感，那么他们的私人生活和职业生活之间的区别就有崩溃的危险。人们可能会发现技术暴露了他们的部分情感生活，并迫使他们解释或捍卫它们，而不是自己决定要透露什么。 普雷金特在工作场所之外也看到了类似的紧张局势。她想象政府代表在发生致命事件后公开道歉。然而，ERT 表明他们并没有感到真正的悲伤或遗憾。公众没有听到道歉，而是......

body.en: Peter J McKosky celebrates the return of the river otter after a century to New York, but notes that hundreds are violently killed in traps every year elsewhere in the state Your report on the river otter’s return to New York City’s Bronx River after a century’s absence ( 19 August ) is genuinely wonderful news – proof that patient ecological restoration works. But it sits uneasily alongside a fact rarely mentioned: New York state still permits the trapping and killing of hundreds of river otters every year, purely for recreation. State wildlife data shows an average annual toll of around 900 otters , sometimes over 1,100, killed in body-gripping and leg-hold traps designed to crush, hold, drown or kill by force. Otters are recognised as an indicator species – their presence signals genuine ecosystem health. There is no overpopulation crisis and, with the fur trade in serious decline, barely an economic rationale left. What remains is the recreational interest of a small minority of trappers. Continue reading...

title.en: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
title.zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，世界海洋达到有记录以来的最高温度

summary.en: The record "is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress", according to Dr Samantha Burgess from the European Copernicus climate change service.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The world's oceans are hotter than ever recorded, new data suggests, as they suffer from human-caused climate change and the growing El Niño weather phenomenon.

The average surface temperature of the planet's seas outside the polar regions hit 21.1C (70F) on Saturday, according to figures from the European Copernicus climate change service.

That edges past the 21.09C recorded on three separate days in March 2024, and is far above average for the time of year.

Warmer oceans can have wide-reaching consequences, including supercharging extreme weather, raising sea levels and harming marine life.

"This record is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress," said Dr Samantha Burgess, deputy director of Copernicus.

"El Niño is adding heat to the system, but it is doing so on top of decades of human-driven warming," she added.

The data is based on sea temperatures 10m (32ft 10in) below the surface, using measurements from buoys, ships and satellites, which are combined to produce a global estimate.

While the margin of record is currently very small and any global estimate comes with uncertainties, scientists say its timing is particularly notable.

Average worldwide sea temperatures tend to reach their yearly peak in March or April, which corresponds to the end of summer in the southern hemisphere - and not in August.

The southern hemisphere contains more of the planet's ocean surface than the northern hemisphere and so exerts a bigger influence on average sea temperatures.

What is especially concerning to scientists is that the oceans are already so hot when the natural El Niño weather phenomenon is still some way off its expected peak.

El Niño brings unusually warm waters to the surface of the eastern and central tropical Pacific Ocean. Warmer waters across such a large area means that global average temperatures typically spike too.

El Niño is expected to keep strengthening until Christmas time, with scientists warning that it is on course to be the strongest in centuries .

"The fact that we are already breaking records is an early indicator of how strong the El Niño is becoming," said Dr Jeremy Grist, senior research fellow at the National Oceanography Centre in Southampton.

"All things being equal we might expect the ocean temperature record to be broken again in March [or] April 2027," he added.

The waters far away from El Niño's Pacific hunting ground are also extremely warm, including around the UK and Europe.

The western English Channel has seen almost continuous marine heatwave conditions for more than three years, peaking at 7C above normal in July, according to Prof Tim Smyth, director of science at Plymouth Marine Laboratory.

Scientists say such widespread warmth around the planet is a clear sign of the growing effect...
body.zh: 新数据显示，由于人为气候变化和日益严重的厄尔尼诺天气现象，世界海洋的温度比以往任何时候都要高。 根据欧洲哥白尼气候变化服务机构的数据，周六极地以外的地球海洋表面平均温度达到 21.1 摄氏度（70 华氏度）。 这一气温略高于 2024 年 3 月连续三天记录的 21.09 摄氏度，远高于一年中该时期的平均气温。 海洋变暖可能会产生广泛的影响，包括加剧极端天气、海平面上升和损害海洋生物。 哥白尼副主任萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士说：“这一记录是海洋压力日益增大的又一个明显信号。” 她补充说：“厄尔尼诺现象正在给系统增加热量，但这是在数十年人为导致的变暖的基础上发生的。” 该数据基于海面以下 10 m（32 英尺 10 英寸）的海水温度，使用浮标、船舶和卫星的测量结果，将这些数据结合起来得出全球估计值。 虽然目前的记录差距非常小，而且任何全球估计都存在不确定性，但科学家表示，其时机尤其值得注意。 全球平均海水温度往往在三月或四月达到年度峰值，这对应于南半球的夏末，而不是八月。 南半球比北半球拥有更多的地球海洋表面，因此对平均海洋温度的影响更大。 让科学家们特别担心的是，当自然厄尔尼诺天气现象距离预期峰值还有一段距离时，海洋已经如此炎热。 厄尔尼诺现象给东部和中部热带太平洋表面带来异常温暖的海水。如此大面积的水域变暖意味着全球平均气温通常也会飙升。 厄尔尼诺现象预计将持续加强，直到圣诞节期间，科学家警告称，这将是几个世纪以来最强烈的一次。 南安普敦国家海洋学中心高级研究员杰里米·格里斯特博士说：“我们已经打破记录这一事实是厄尔尼诺现象变得多么强烈的早期指标。” 他补充道：“在所有条件相同的情况下，我们预计海洋温度记录将在 2027 年 3 月或 4 月再次被打破。” 远离厄尔尼诺现象的太平洋狩猎场的水域也非常温暖，包括英国和欧洲周围的水域。 普利茅斯海洋实验室科学主任蒂姆·史密斯教授表示，三年多来，西英吉利海峡几乎持续出现海洋热浪天气，7月份的最高气温比正常水平高出7摄氏度。 科学家表示，地球上如此普遍的变暖现象是这种影响日益增强的明显迹象......

body.en: The conservationist Harry Green was a naturalist of the amateur school, with an encyclopedic knowledge of British wildlife based on a lifetime in the field. Though born and brought up in Oxfordshire, he spent the whole of his adult life in his adopted county of Worcestershire. Harry, who has died aged 92, remembered being kept awake during the second world war by calling corncrakes in the meadows near his home. Later he strove, against the odds, to save Britain’s last colony of marsh warblers near Pershore. These, and the corncrakes, eventually vanished, but other species, such as hobbies, little egrets and Cetti’s warblers, did arrive and thrive. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自然资源保护主义者哈里·格林（Harry Green）是一位业余博物学家，凭借在该领域的一生，对英国野生动物有了百科全书式的了解。尽管他在牛津郡出生和长大，但他的整个成年生活都是在他收养的伍斯特郡度过的。已去世 92 岁的哈利记得，在第二次世界大战期间，他因在家附近的草地上叫玉米秧鸡而无法入睡。后来，他克服重重困难，努力拯救英国珀肖尔附近最后的沼泽莺群。这些鸟和玉米秧鸡最终消失了，但其他物种，如白鹭、小白鹭和塞蒂莺，确实出现并繁衍生息。继续阅读...

title.en: Common medications may change your gut for years

summary.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and benzodiazepines. Some effects were still detectable years later, suggesting past medication use may strongly influence the gut bacteria people carry today.
body.zh: 常见药物可能会在服用最后一剂药物后很长时间内重塑肠道微生物组。在一项对 2,500 多人进行的研究中，研究人员发现持久的微生物变化不仅与抗生素有关，还与抗抑郁药、β-受体阻滞剂、降酸药和苯二氮卓类药物有关。几年后仍然可以检测到一些影响，这表明过去的药物使用可能会强烈影响人们今天携带的肠道细菌。

title.en: Bird flu is spreading. Your backyard feeder could make it worse
title.zh: 禽流感正在蔓延。你的后院喂食器可能会让情况变得更糟

summary.en: Backyard bird feeders could become unexpected hotspots for H5N1 as Australia’s bird flu outbreak spreads, bringing species together in ways that rarely occur naturally. Experts say stopping feeding is safest, while smaller amounts of food, no hand-feeding, and careful cleaning...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Backyard bird feeding is one of our country’s most popular pastimes. Research reveals about half of Australian households feed wild birds, with many people doing so daily.

However, this practice could act as a superspreader event – where a disease infects an unusually high number of people or animals – of the H5N1 virus. This deadly strain of bird flu has already decimated wild bird and mammal populations worldwide. It is now spreading across Australia, most recently killing more than 1,000 crested terns and a long-nosed fur seal, the first detection in a mainland mammal.

Although many Australians feed wild birds, the practice is controversial . This is mainly due to concerns about people offering unsuitable foods and birds becoming dependent on humans.

So why is backyard bird feeding such a problem when it comes to bird flu? And can we do it safely?

People feed wild birds for various reasons , including to provide food during tough times or simply enjoy their presence. Most care deeply about their avian companions and believe feeding them is helpful .

Feeding wild birds heightens the risk of disease transmission at feeding locations . When we offer supplementary food, such as seeds or meat scraps, this attracts birds of many different species in a combination and number that would not happen in nature. They may carry deadly diseases, such as the H5N1 virus, and potentially spread them to other birds.

This can create a transmission hotspot right on our back deck. And catching bird flu can push our most threatened species, such as the orange-bellied parrot , to the brink of extinction.

The fatal effects of H5N1 are not only contained to birds. Scavenger animals such as possums, red foxes and crows can be exposed to the virus while devouring the carcasses of infected birds. Humans in close contact with infected wildlife, such as wildlife carers and veterinarians, can contract H5N1. However, human infection is rare and typically only causes mild symptoms.

Backyard bird feeding may seem like a harmless hobby. But given how many people do it, and the risks it poses to both birds and people, bird feeding activities could lead to many more wildlife deaths .

The most effective strategy is to stop feeding birds altogether. If you don’t offer food to wild birds, they will be less likely to congregate in your backyard or garden. And they will be fine without your help. Our previous research found most birds that visit feeders obtain most of their nutrition from natural sources, such as insects and worms. So the food we provide is a snack, not an essential meal.

Having feeders full of seeds and leftover meat will attract more birds. So to discourage them from congregating, simply provide less food. Much like COVID-era social...
body.zh: 后院喂鸟是我国最受欢迎的消遣之一。研究显示，大约一半的澳大利亚家庭喂养野生鸟类，其中许多人每天都这样做。 然而，这种做法可能会成为 H5N1 病毒的超级传播事件——一种疾病感染异常多的人或动物。这种致命的禽流感病毒已经导致世界各地的野生鸟类和哺乳动物数量大量减少。它目前正在澳大利亚各地蔓延，最近导致 1,000 多只凤头燕鸥和一只长鼻海豹死亡，这是首次在大陆哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 尽管许多澳大利亚人喂养野生鸟类，但这种做法存在争议。这主要是由于担心人们提供不合适的食物以及鸟类变得依赖人类。 那么，为什么在禽流感方面，后院喂鸟会成为一个问题呢？我们可以安全地做到这一点吗？ 人们出于各种原因喂养野生鸟类，包括在困难时期提供食物或只是享受它们的存在。大多数人非常关心他们的鸟类同伴，并相信喂养它们是有帮助的。 喂养野鸟会增加喂养地点疾病传播的风险。当我们提供补充食物（例如种子或肉末）时，会吸引许多不同物种的鸟类，其组合和数量在自然界中是不会发生的。它们可能携带致命疾病，例如 H5N1 病毒，并有可能将其传播给其他鸟类。 这可以在我们的后甲板上创建一个传输热点。感染禽流感可能会将橙腹鹦鹉等最受威胁的物种推向灭绝的边缘。 H5N1 的致命影响不仅限于鸟类。负鼠、红狐和乌鸦等食腐动物在吞食受感染鸟类的尸体时可能会接触到病毒。与受感染野生动物密切接触的人类，例如野生动物护理人员和兽医，可能会感染 H5N1。然而，人类感染很少见，通常只会引起轻微症状。 后院喂鸟似乎是一种无害的爱好。但考虑到有多少人这样做，以及它对鸟类和人类造成的风险，鸟类喂养活动可能会导致更多野生动物死亡。 最有效的策略是完全停止喂养鸟类。如果您不向野鸟提供食物，它们就不太可能聚集在您的后院或花园里。没有你的帮助，他们也会没事的。我们之前的研究发现，大多数访问喂食器的鸟类从昆虫和蠕虫等天然来源获取大部分营养。所以我们提供的食物是零食，而不是必需的膳食。 装满种子和剩余肉的喂食器会吸引更多的鸟类。因此，为了阻止他们聚集，只需提供更少的食物即可。就像新冠病毒时代的社交......

title.en: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
title.zh: 一条幽灵般的星带揭示了隐藏的暗物质

summary.en: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. Because the stars trace the galaxy’s gravity, researchers used the stream to estimate how much invisible dark matter surrounds it and how...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For billions of years, an ancient cluster of stars has been gradually coming apart, shedding stars that now form a faint, narrow ribbon across space. That delicate structure is offering astronomers a new way to investigate one of the universe's biggest mysteries.

An international research team, including an astrophysicist from Northwestern University, has identified the first stellar stream of this type ever observed outside the Milky Way. Astronomers have long predicted that such streams should exist around other galaxies, but their extreme faintness has made them difficult to detect.

The newly discovered stream also offers scientists an unusual tool for studying dark matter, which remains one of the major unanswered questions in astrophysics. By analyzing the stream's shape, researchers reconstructed the gravitational field of its host galaxy and used that information to determine how unseen dark matter influenced the stars' paths.

The findings could eventually help scientists investigate how dark matter is distributed across many different galaxies and throughout the universe.

"The stars in a stellar stream all travel along nearly the same orbit, and that orbit is shaped by the galaxy's gravity," said Northwestern's Tjitske Starkenburg, who coauthored the study. "By modeling that gravity, we can estimate the galaxy's total mass. We already know roughly how much of that mass comes from visible matter like stars, so the rest must be dark matter."

Starkenburg, an expert in extragalactic astronomy, is a research assistant professor at Northwestern's Center for Interdisciplinary Exploration and Research in Astrophysics. The study was co-led by Julie Kiel Holm of the University of Copenhagen and Sarah Pearson of the Technical University of Denmark.

Globular clusters are densely packed groups of stars held together by gravity. As one of these clusters travels around its host galaxy, the galaxy's gravitational pull can slowly strip stars away from it.

Those stars do not simply scatter in every direction. Instead, they tend to continue along nearly the same orbital path, creating long, thin stellar streams that retain information about the gravitational forces they have experienced.

Astronomers have identified dozens of streams produced by globular clusters inside the Milky Way. Until now, however, no comparable stream had been detected in another galaxy. Such structures are generally so faint that they disappear against the light of their host galaxies.

The breakthrough came through archival observations from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope presented by study coauthors David Sand and Catherine Fielder, both astronomers at the University of Arizona. While study coauthor David Hendel was examining images of the ultra-diffuse galaxy UGC 9050-Dw1 for...
body.zh: 数十亿年来，古老的星团逐渐分裂，脱落的恒星现在在太空中形成一条微弱而狭窄的丝带。这种微妙的结构为天文学家提供了一种研究宇宙最大谜团之一的新方法。 包括西北大学天体物理学家在内的一个国际研究小组发现了在银河系外首次观测到的此类恒星流。天文学家长期以来一直预测，此类流应该存在于其他星系周围，但它们的极度微弱使它们难以被发现。 新发现的暗物质流还为科学家提供了一种不寻常的工具来研究暗物质，暗物质仍然是天体物理学中尚未解答的主要问题之一。通过分析该流的形状，研究人员重建了其宿主星系的引力场，并利用该信息来确定看不见的暗物质如何影响恒星的路径。 这些发现最终可以帮助科学家研究暗物质如何分布在许多不同的星系和整个宇宙中。 “恒星流中的恒星都沿着几乎相同的轨道运行，而该轨道是由星系的引力决定的，”西北大学的蒂斯克·斯塔肯堡（Tjitske Starkenburg）说，他是这项研究的合著者。 “通过对引力进行建模，我们可以估计星系的总质量。我们已经大致知道其中有多少质量来自恒星等可见物质，所以其余的一定是暗物质。” 斯塔肯伯格是河外天文学专家，西北大学天体物理学跨学科探索与研究中心的研究助理教授。这项研究由哥本哈根大学的 Julie Kiel Holm 和丹麦技术大学的 Sarah Pearson 共同领导。 球状星团是由重力聚集在一起的密集恒星群。当这些星团之一围绕其宿主星系运行时，星系的引力会慢慢地将恒星从它身上剥离。 这些星星并不简单地分散在各个方向。相反，它们倾向于继续沿着几乎相同的轨道路径运行，产生又长又细的恒星流，保留有关它们所经历的引力的信息。 天文学家已经发现了银河系内部球状星团产生的数十条流。然而，到目前为止，尚未在另一个星系中检测到类似的流。这些结构通常非常微弱，以至于它们在宿主星系的光线下消失了。 这一突破来自美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的档案观测，该观测由研究合著者、亚利桑那大学的天文学家大卫·桑德和凯瑟琳·菲尔德提出。当研究合著者 David Hendel 正在检查超漫射星系 UGC 9050-Dw1 的图像时……

title.en: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster
title.zh: 睡眠过多或过少都可能使身体衰老得更快

summary.en: Both too little and too much sleep may be linked to faster aging throughout the body. Researchers analyzing 23 biological aging clocks found the lowest aging levels among people sleeping about 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day. Short or long sleep was also associated with numerous...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A new analysis of biological aging across the human body suggests that both sleeping too little and sleeping too much are associated with faster aging in the brain, heart, lungs, immune system, and other organs. These sleep patterns were also linked to a broad range of diseases.

"Previous studies have found that sleep is largely linked to aging and the pathological burden of the brain. Our study goes further and shows that too little and too much sleep are associated with faster aging in nearly every organ, supporting the idea that sleep is important in maintaining organ health within a coordinated brain-body network, including metabolic balance and a healthy immune system," says study leader Junhao Wen, assistant professor of radiology at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.

Scientists are increasingly using aging clocks to estimate whether a person is aging biologically faster or slower than their chronological age. These tools rely on machine learning and biological information (e.g., proteins from a minimally invasive blood test) to calculate patterns associated with aging.

Many aging clocks provide a single measure for the entire body. However, different organs can age at different speeds. One familiar example is the decline in ovarian function that contributes to the biological clock associated with female fertility.

Wen and his colleagues have been developing aging clocks that focus on individual organs. The goal is to provide more detailed and potentially more personalized information about a person's health.

"Everyone is excited by these aging clocks and their ability to predict disease and mortality risk," Wen says. "But to me, the more exciting question is, can we link aging clocks to a lifestyle factor that can be modified in time to slow aging?"

Sleep offered researchers an ideal way to explore that question because mounting evidence suggests that sleep plays an important role in health. Wen also had a personal interest in the issue.

"I'm also a light sleeper and was getting worried about the effects on myself," says Wen.

To create the aging clocks, Wen used information from about half a million participants in the UK Biobank. Machine learning was applied to identify biological signatures associated with aging in different organs.

The researchers built clocks using several types of information, including structural measurements from medical imaging, proteins associated with specific organs, and molecules detected in the blood.

"In the liver, for example, we have an aging clock built with protein data, an aging clock of metabolic data, and an aging clock of imaging data," Wen says. "This allows us to see whether sleep is distinctively associated with aging clocks derived from multiple omics and...
body.zh: 一项对人体生物衰老的新分析表明，睡眠过少和睡眠过多都与大脑、心脏、肺、免疫系统和其他器官的加速衰老有关。这些睡眠模式也与多种疾病有关。 “之前的研究发现，睡眠在很大程度上与衰老和大脑的病理负担有关。我们的研究进一步表明，睡眠太少和太多都与几乎每个器官的衰老速度加快有关，这支持了这样的观点，即睡眠对于维持协调的脑体网络中的器官健康非常重要，包括代谢平衡和健康的免疫系统，”研究负责人、哥伦比亚大学瓦格洛斯内外科医学院放射学助理教授温俊豪说。 科学家越来越多地使用衰老时钟来估计一个人的生物学衰老速度是否比实际年龄快或慢。这些工具依靠机器学习和生物信息（例如，微创血液测试中的蛋白质）来计算与衰老相关的模式。 许多老化时钟为整个身体提供单一测量。然而，不同的器官会以不同的速度老化。一个熟悉的例子是卵巢功能下降，这会影响与女性生育能力相关的生物钟。 温和他的同事们一直在开发关注个体器官的衰老时钟。目标是提供有关个人健康的更详细且可能更个性化的信息。 “每个人都对这些衰老时钟及其预测疾病和死亡风险的能力感到兴奋，”文说。 “但对我来说，更令人兴奋的问题是，我们能否将衰老时钟与可以及时改变以减缓衰老的生活方式因素联系起来？” 睡眠为研究人员提供了探索这个问题的理想方法，因为越来越多的证据表明睡眠在健康中发挥着重要作用。温家宝对这个问题也有个人兴趣。 “我的睡眠质量也很浅，我很担心这对自己造成的影响，”文说。 为了创建衰老时钟，温使用了英国生物银行约 50 万参与者的信息。应用机器学习来识别与不同器官衰老相关的生物特征。 研究人员利用多种类型的信息构建了时钟，包括医学成像的结构测量、与特定器官相关的蛋白质以及血液中检测到的分子。 “例如，在肝脏中，我们有一个由蛋白质数据构建的衰老时钟、一个代谢数据的衰老时钟和一个成像数据的衰老时钟，”文说。 “这使我们能够了解睡眠是否与来自多个组学的衰老时钟有明显的相关性，并且......

title.en: UK's rarest bird of prey rears new chicks in secret location
title.zh: 英国最稀有的猛禽在秘密地点抚养新雏鸟

summary.en: The Montagu Harrier successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The UK's rarest bird of prey has successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location, the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) has reported.

A male Montagu's harrier, known as "AU" by conservationists, bred with two different females, rearing six chicks across two nests on English farmland.

Montagu's harriers were put on a "red list" of birds most at risk in the UK in 2021. Numbers have declined from a high of nine successful nests in 2011, to no evidence of successful breeding between 2020 and 2024.

An RSPB spokesperson said: "We are doing our absolute utmost to save this iconic species in the UK and are delighted with six flying juveniles this year."

The charity said careful monitoring, in partnership with the farmers on whose land the birds nested, meant the nests were protected by fences to exclude ground predators such as foxes.

The single male Montagu's harrier has also been working very hard to keep his two nests of hungry chicks fed.

The BBC was given exclusive access to the nest and was able to witness some of the spectacular feeding behaviour of the raptors: the male drops prey in mid-air and the female rolls upside down to catch it in her talons.

These slender, long-winged raptors make an epic annual migration to Africa in winter and return to Europe to nest over summer, often setting up home in agricultural fields.

But little is known about the behaviour of juvenile harriers once they leave the nest. This year, for the first time, the RSPB has fitted two of the chicks with satellite tags in the hope of providing the birds with better protection.

"It will allow us for the first time ever to work out where they're going, what migration route, how long they'll spend there, and will they come back to the UK in the first year or the second year," said Mark Thomas, head of investigations at the RSPB.

It is also hoped the tagging can better protect the rare birds from having their nests, on the ground, hidden among crops, inadvertently destroyed.

"This is a species right on the brink, and climate change is not helping that. The harvest here, for example, this year, was like a month earlier than in previous years. So it almost puts any Montagu's harrier nest at the peril of inadvertently being destroyed by farm machinery," said Thomas.

Conservationists have urged birders to look out for the youngsters, and report any sightings by emailing the RSPB's Montagu's hotline at montys@rspb.org.uk.
body.zh: 据英国皇家鸟类保护协会 (RSPB) 报道，英国最稀有的猛禽已连续第二年在同一秘密地点成功筑巢。 一只雄性蒙塔古鹞被自然资源保护者称为“AU”，与两只不同的雌性一起繁殖，在英国农田的两个巢中养育了六只雏鸟。 2021 年，蒙塔古鹞被列入英国最危险鸟类的“红色名单”。数量已从 2011 年成功筑巢 9 个的高峰下降到 2020 年至 2024 年间没有成功繁殖的证据。 皇家鸟类保护协会的一位发言人表示：“我们正在尽最大努力拯救英国的这一标志性物种，我们对今年有六只飞行幼崽感到高兴。” 该慈善机构表示，与鸟儿筑巢的土地上的农民合作进行仔细监控，意味着鸟巢受到栅栏的保护，以排除狐狸等地面掠食者。 单身雄性蒙塔古鹞也一直在非常努力地工作，以保证他的两窝饥饿的雏鸟有吃的。 英国广播公司获得了进入猛禽巢穴的独家访问权限，并目睹了猛禽的一些壮观的进食行为：雄性猛禽将猎物抛在半空中，雌性则翻滚着用爪子捕捉猎物。 这些细长、长翼的猛禽每年冬天都会进行一次史诗般的迁徙，前往非洲，并在夏天返回欧洲筑巢，通常在农田里安家。 但人们对幼年鹞离开巢穴后的行为知之甚少。今年，皇家鸟类保护协会首次为其中两只小鸟安装了卫星标签，希望为这些小鸟提供更好的保护。 英国皇家鸟类保护协会调查负责人马克·托马斯表示：“这将使我们有史以来第一次弄清楚他们要去哪里、迁徙路线是什么、他们将在那里待多久，以及他们会在第一年还是第二年回到英国。” 人们还希望标签能够更好地保护这些稀有鸟类的巢穴，它们在地面上、隐藏在农作物中的巢穴不会被无意中破坏。 “这是一个濒临灭绝的物种，气候变化对此无济于事。例如，今年这里的收成比往年早了一个月。因此，这几乎使任何蒙塔古鹞巢都面临着被农业机械无意中摧毁的危险，”托马斯说。 环保人士敦促观鸟者留意这些幼鸟，并通过电子邮件报告皇家鸟类保护协会蒙塔古热线：montys@rspb.org.uk。

summary.en: Young employment in AI-impacted fields down 19% compared to more AI-resistant occupations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: For years , AI industry watchers of all stripes have been warning of a coming jobs apocalypse driven by ultra-intelligent AI systems that will be able to replicate most human tasks more cheaply. Now, newly updated research from Stanford University economists suggests AI seems to be causing significant entry-level job losses for younger workers in some fields, even as older workers appear largely unaffected so far. The August 2026 edition of "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence" updates and revises a paper of the same name published last year with fresh data and refined statistics. In that update, the Stanford researchers find the employment trends they identified for entry-level workers last year are persisting and expanding. Specifically, employment levels for workers aged 22 to 25 in the most "AI-exposed" occupations are now 19 percent below those of their peers in fields less exposed to AI disruption. Last year, that gap measured just 13 percent. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 多年来，各行各业的人工智能行业观察家一直警告称，由超智能人工智能系统驱动的就业灾难即将到来，这些系统将能够以更便宜的成本复制大多数人类任务。现在，斯坦福大学经济学家最新的研究表明，人工智能似乎正在导致某些领域的年轻工人大量入门级失业，尽管老年工人到目前为止似乎基本上没有受到影响。 2026 年 8 月版《煤矿里的金丝雀？人工智能近期就业影响的六个事实》更新和修订了去年发表的同名论文，提供了新的数据和精细的统计数据。在那次更新中，斯坦福大学的研究人员发现，他们去年确定的入门级工人的就业趋势正在持续存在并扩大。具体来说，从事“受人工智能影响最大”职业的 22 至 25 岁工人的就业水平目前比受人工智能影响较少的领域的同龄人低 19%。去年，这一差距仅为 13%。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Data centers become "killer application" for new power transformer tech
title.zh: 数据中心成为新型电力变压器技术的“杀手级应用”

summary.en: Solid-state transformers could also benefit EV charging and someday households.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Data centers have become the largest driver of surging electricity demand that is straining US power grids. But the AI data center boom has also accelerated investment in a technology that could provide a silver lining for everyone—solid-state power transformers that replace industrial-age technology with modern power electronics. Power grids currently rely on conventional transformer technology that is painstakingly assembled by hand and has a fundamental design dating back to the 1880s. Two copper wire coils manually wound around a steel core create electromagnetic fields that help step up voltage levels of alternating current electricity for long-distance transmission or step down voltage levels for the electricity use of homes and businesses. The largest power transformers cannot be mass-manufactured but are instead custom-built for each utility company’s electrical substations. Manufacturing constraints, coupled with the scramble to upgrade US power infrastructure, have meant utility companies and other customers must wait up to several years for delivery of new power transformers. That is not only a problem for expanding power grid infrastructure to support growing electricity demand, but also delays the process of replacing aging power transformers. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 数据中心已成为电力需求激增的最大推动力，这给美国电网带来了压力。但人工智能数据中心的繁荣也加速了对一项技术的投资，这项技术可以为每个人带来一线希望——用现代电力电子技术取代工业时代技术的固态电力变压器。目前，电网依赖于手工精心组装的传统变压器技术，其基本设计可以追溯到 1880 年代。手动缠绕在钢芯上的两个铜线线圈会产生电磁场，有助于提高交流电的电压水平以进行长距离传输，或降低电压水平以供家庭和企业用电。最大的电力变压器无法大规模制造，而是为每个公用事业公司的变电站定制。制造限制，加上美国电力基础设施升级的争夺，意味着公用事业公司和其他客户必须等待数年才能交付新的电力变压器。这不仅是扩大电网基础设施以支持不断增长的电力需求的问题，而且还推迟了更换老化电力变压器的进程。阅读全文 评论

title.en: RFK Jr. may upend how vaccine recommendations are categorized
title.zh: RFK Jr. 可能会颠覆疫苗建议的分类方式

summary.en: There are currently 3 categories. Without reason, RFK Jr. is considering changes.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Under anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the US health department is considering changing how vaccine recommendations are categorized and described. The move creates the possibility that vaccinations currently considered "routine" or "universal" could be given new designations that sound less definitive or more conditional, such as "recommended with qualification" or recommended based on "shared clinical decision-making." Kennedy has made no new rules or recommendations for the categories yet. However, he laid out ideas and possibilities in a Request for Information (RFI) posted online Friday and published in the Federal Register on Monday . In the 10-page document , Kennedy poses questions about the current categories and asks the public to weigh in on ideas for how to change or replace them. The deadline to comment on the questions and ideas is September 20. Currently, there are three categories of vaccination recommendations granted by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which is informed by a panel of independent expert advisors, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP). The three categories are: routine, otherwise considered universal (a recommendation that everyone should get a vaccine); risk-based recommendations (only certain groups at higher risk should get a vaccine); and recommendations based on "shared clinical decision-making," or SCDM (a flexible but uncommon recommendation for vaccination based on the characteristics, values, and preferences of a patient and the judgment of their healthcare provider). Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在反疫苗的卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的领导下，美国卫生部门正在考虑改变疫苗建议的分类和描述方式。此举创造了一种可能性，即目前被认为是“常规”或“通用”的疫苗可能会被赋予新的名称，这些名称听起来不那么明确或更有条件，例如“有资格推荐”或基于“共同临床决策”推荐。肯尼迪尚未针对这些类别制定新的规则或建议。不过，他在周五在线发布并于周一在《联邦公报》上发表的信息请求 (RFI) 中阐述了想法和可能性。在这份长达 10 页的文件中，肯尼迪提出了有关当前类别的问题，并要求公众就如何改变或取代它们提出意见。对问题和想法发表评论的截止日期是 9 月 20 日。目前，疾病控制和预防中心授予了三类疫苗接种建议，这些建议由独立专家顾问小组、免疫实践咨询委员会 (ACIP) 提供信息。这三个类别是：常规的，否则被认为是普遍的（建议每个人都应该接种疫苗）；基于风险的建议（只有某些风险较高的群体才应该接种疫苗）；基于“共同临床决策”或 SCDM 的建议（根据患者的特征、价值观和偏好及其医疗保健提供者的判断而提出的灵活但不常见的疫苗接种建议）。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Ads and tracking infiltrated TVs. Now they're coming for monitors.
title.zh: 广告和跟踪渗透到电视中。现在他们来找显示器了。

summary.en: Monitor vendors are playing with fire.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Ads and tracking have turned TVs into privacy nightmares . Both are so widespread among smart TVs that I’ve written a guide for avoiding them . One recommendation in that guide is to use a computer monitor. But in recent years, monitors have become more capable of pushing ads and tracking users. Without more straightforward approaches from vendors, such as easily comprehensible privacy policies and avoiding inappropriate ads, monitors are dangerously encroaching into smart-TV-like territory. LG monitors’ McAfee ads LG lost some trust after a recent report that some of its monitors installed McAfee pop-up ads onto connected computers . Since at least 2024 , some of these displays installed an app, LG Monitor App Installer, onto connected computers under the cover of driver updates installed through Windows Update.
